parameters.help_en: The complete JSON string. For more information, see the following details
parameters.help_zh: 完整JSON字符串信息，具体内容参见以下详细信息
parameters.name: json_str

Code.description_en:
The result code. A value of 200 indicates success.

If the value is not 200, the request failed. You can use this field to determine the cause of the failure
Code.description_zh:
结果代码，200表示成功。

若为别的值则表示失败，调用方可根据此字段判断失败原因

Data.description_en: The quality inspection score after the review. This field is returned when the review results are saved
Data.description_zh: 保存成功时返回复核后的质检得分

Message.description_en: The error details when an error occurs. The value is successful when the request is successful
Message.description_zh: 出错时表示出错详情，成功时为successful

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful.

You can use this field to determine whether the request is successful:

true: The request is successful.
false or null: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。

调用方可根据此字段来判断请求是否成功：

true表示成功
false/null表示失败
